pages.text: It is always evening there. The trees are older than anything at home, and they are not friendly. Parts of the forest lie under curses that lift only when their guardian falls.
The serpent first, coiled in a courtyard of hedges. Then the tower, and the pale sorcerer at its top, who fought with stolen lightning and called his dead to help. I nearly stayed there forever.
Under the roots I found liveroot; with iron and a little gold it became ironwood. Ironwood wrapped around the sorcerer's cold essence made something that ticked and breathed: a steam core.
I went into the dusk once and came back with one thing, and that one thing changed my whole world. I never needed to go back. I'm still not sure if that was a mercy or a warning.
Ironwood, a Lich's essence and bronze, wound tight. It wakes every steam engine you will ever build.
pages.title: Mark of the Twilight
